scope: Generic workflow support inventory; no listed connection is activated by this repository.

availabilityNotes.user-reported: The user reported access; native integration was not tested here.
availabilityNotes.partial-user-reported: Python or Microsoft 365 Copilot was reported; SQL connections or Copilot Studio availability still require verification.
availabilityNotes.confirm-at-work: Product, version, licensing, permissions and enabled capabilities must be confirmed.
availabilityNotes.optional-evaluation: Candidate only; not assumed installed or approved.
availabilityNotes.capability-only: The underlying proprietary software is not verified.
availabilityNotes.local-implementation: Code exists in this repository; the service must be explicitly started locally.
